reasoning_text:
We need to analyze each couplet's conceptual meaning.

Option 1: "بی تو اگر سرخ بود از اثر غازه (سرخاب) شود - روی کسی سرخ نشد بی مدد ...". Means: Without you, even if something is red (like a flower), it won't become red; someone's face won't be red without your help. Essentially expresses dependence on beloved; without the beloved, beauty/redness cannot be attained. Theme: longing, dependence, perhaps love's necessity.

Option 2: "عالم پیر دگر باره جوان خواهد شد - نفس باد صبا مشک فشان خواهد شد". Means: The old world will become young again; the breath of the morning breeze will be perfumed (like musk). This is about renewal, rejuvenation, optimism about future transformation. Theme: renewal, hope.

Option 3: "مرا به خیر تو امید نیست شر مرسان - امیدوار بود آدمی به خیر کسان". Means: I have no hope in your goodness, do not send evil; a person hopes for the goodness of others. Might be about hope in others' goodness? It seems contradictory: "I have no hope in your goodness, do not send evil" maybe expresses lack of hope? Actually: "مرا به خیر تو امید نیست شر مرسان" could mean "I have no hope in your goodness, do not send me evil". Then second line: "امیدوار بود آدمی به خیر کسان" = "Man hopes for the goodness of people". So overall theme: hope in others' goodness, but speaker lacks hope. Might be about hope vs hopelessness.

Option 4: "پایان شب سیه سپید است - در نومیدی بسی امید است". Means: The end of the black night is white (i.e., dawn); in despair there is much hope. So expresses optimism, hope after darkness.

Thus options 2 and 4 share theme of hope/renewal. Option 3 also about hope but maybe more about lack of hope? Option 1 is about dependence on beloved, not about hope. So likely option 1 deviates.

Check if any other share similar theme: Option 2: world rejuvenates, optimism. Option 4: hope after despair. Option 3: talk about hope in others, but also says "no hope in your goodness". Might be ambiguous but still about hope concept. Option 1 is about love/beauty, not hope. So answer likely 1.

Thus final answer: 1.
